retrievalProfile.description: A classic 1980s portrait layout featuring a centered subject with a two-tier typographic hierarchy combining a bold serif and a fluid script.

recipe.visualDefinition: A medium-shot portrait of a smiling man in rustic attire, positioned against a dark, warm-toned background with soft side-lighting and a vertical architectural element on the right. The typography is clustered in the upper-left corner, featuring a large, overlapping serif title and a secondary script subtitle.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject centered horizontally with a slight lean toward the right
Typography anchored in the top-left negative space
Warm brown tones in the background and clothing unified by golden-hour lighting
Vertical lines of the fence/trellis balancing the horizontal shoulders of the subject
coreInvariants: Overlapping character placement in the primary display text
Diagonal upward slant for the secondary script text
Soft-focus background with a distinct vertical texture on one side

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Centered medium shot, waist-up, filling approximately 70% of the vertical frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and glasses, highlighted by the brightest light source.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the bold typography in the top left, moves down to the subject's face, and follows the arms down to the bottom center.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Concentrated in the upper left and upper right corners to allow for text and atmospheric depth.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm browns and earth tones (background and leather vest).
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Pale greens and creams (plaid shirt and foliage).
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Muted lavender/purple (primary text) and white (secondary text).
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with high value contrast on the subject's face and shirt against a dark, low-value background.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: High-contrast transitional serif and casual brush script.
letterConstructionRules: Primary text uses tight kerning with intentional character overlaps
Secondary text mimics natural handwriting with a consistent 15-degree upward slant
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'D' in the second line of the title is enlarged to tuck under the first line
Script letters have varying line weights to simulate a felt-tip pen

composition.relationshipToImage: angled across the subject's shoulder area

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast serif for authority paired with a casual script for personal intimacy.
graphicDevices: Vertical trellis/fence on the right edge to frame the subject

preserve: The upward slant of the script

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the high-contrast, 70s-80s serif aesthetic with unique character shapes.
Provides a similar casual, handwritten brush feel for the subtitle.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a medium-shot portrait of a man with 1970s-style feathered hair and wire-rimmed glasses, wearing a plaid shirt and leather vest. Use warm, low-key studio lighting. Place him against a dark brown background with a vertical wooden trellis and green vines on the right side. Leave significant negative space in the top-left corner.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the primary title in the top-left using a bold, lavender-colored serif font with tight kerning. Below it, add the subtitle in a white, hand-drawn script font, slanted upwards at a 15-degree angle.

verificationChecks: Is the primary text lavender and the secondary text white?
Is the script text slanted upwards?
Is the lighting warm and focused on the face?
Is there a vertical framing element on the right?

adjustableVariables: Specific hue of the lavender text
Density of the foliage on the right
mustRedesign: Avoid using the specific artist's name or likeness
Do not replicate the exact logo of the record label
postGenerationChecks: Check for character overlap in the serif title
Ensure the script font looks like handwriting, not a standard font
Verify the 1980s color palette is maintained
Confirm the subject is looking directly at the camera
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a warm-toned 80s portrait with a top-left typographic cluster consisting of a bold, overlapping serif and an ascending casual script.
